svg.title: Periodic sieve, factorial rectangles, and ramp cuts
svg.desc: The left board packs the same bricks left by period and down by integer. Black dashes mark the ramp cuts on the left, each spanning a brick width of Lambda(q). The red hyperbola joins their centers on an evenly spaced period axis. The center shows the factorial rectangles and log integral. The right shows Lambda(q) above the ramp cuts. No brick is rescaled.

g.aria-label: Periodic sieve layers and the two directions of compaction
The same sieve bricks packed to the left and cut at 16/q minus 1 units

path.aria-label: The hyperbola 16/q minus 1 on an evenly spaced q axis

g.title: Bounding the log integral from 1 to 16
g.desc: Left-endpoint rectangles, the integral of log t, and right-endpoint rectangles share the same scale. Each rectangle splits into one block for each prime factor, with height log p.

g.aria-label: I(16) = integral from 1 to 16 of log t dt

g.title: Regrouping prime blocks and trimming the top in place
g.desc: In the upper plot, equal copies of log p fill the height log q for a prime power q. In the lower plot the black cut segments meet the red guides at the marked points.

g.aria-label: Log q sampled at the integers
Intersections with the actual cut segments

circle.aria-label: All three guides and the cut meet at zero

g.aria-label: Regroup the prime blocks from the bottom-left plot into the bottom-right plot
